result.instructions: Tools for Formcarry, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many submissions did my contact form get this week?"; "Show me the unread submissions on the demo request form."; "Which webhook deliveries failed in the last day?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Formcarry data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run formcarry_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run formcarry_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run formcarry_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. formcarry_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: formcarry_me
tools.title: Show the connected key
tools.description: Show which Formcarry key or connection is in use: its scopes, the teams it covers and the forms it can access. Use it first to check what this connection is allowed to do. Formcarry API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: formcarry_list_email_servers
tools.title: List email servers
tools.description: List the email servers this team can send form notifications and auto replies through. Formcarry API: GET /v1/email-servers.

tools.name: formcarry_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms this key can access, newest first, each with its full configuration (name, endpoint, notifications, redirects). Good first call to find a form id. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

team_id.description: Only this team. Use when the key covers several teams.

tools.name: formcarry_get_form
tools.title: Get a form
tools.description: Get one form by id with its full configuration: notification settings, after-submit behavior and spam protection. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

tools.name: formcarry_list_form_fields
tools.title: List form fields
tools.description: List the field names a form collects, from its newest 2,000 submissions, most used first, with how many submissions carry each name and when it last arrived. Use the counts to spot renamed fields. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}/fields.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

tools.name: formcarry_list_submissions
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List one form's submissions, newest first by default, with optional filters (status, read state, attachments, dates, country, text). Returns next_cursor: pass it back as cursor for the next page; stop when it is null. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}/submissions.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

created_after.description: Created at or after this time (RFC 3339, or milliseconds since the epoch).

created_before.description: Created before this time (RFC 3339, or milliseconds since the epoch).

country.description: Two-letter uppercase country code. Several codes separated by commas (max 20), e.g. DE,AT.

q.description: Only submissions where any field contains this text (literal, case-insensitive, 2-512 characters).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Comma-separated submitted field names to return, e.g. email,name. Other submission data still comes back.

tools.name: formcarry_get_submission
tools.title: Get a submission
tools.description: Get one submission with all its fields, country, read state, spam flag and uploaded files. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}/submissions/{submission_id}.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

tools.name: formcarry_count_submissions
tools.title: Count submissions
tools.description: Count one form's submissions that match the filters, without returning them. Add group_by to count by day, week, month, country, spam, read, or field:<name>. Use it to size a question before listing. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}/submissions/summary.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

created_after.description: Created at or after this time (RFC 3339, or milliseconds since the epoch).

created_before.description: Created before this time (RFC 3339, or milliseconds since the epoch).

country.description: Two-letter uppercase country code. Several codes separated by commas (max 20), e.g. DE,AT.

q.description: Only submissions where any field contains this text (literal, case-insensitive, 2-512 characters).

group_by.description: day, week, month, country, spam, read, or field:<name>. Omit for one total.

tools.name: formcarry_search_submissions
tools.title: Search submissions across forms
tools.description: Search submissions across the 25 most recently active forms this key can read, or the forms you name in form_ids. Returns matches grouped by form. The response says complete: false when the search did not reach every form or match; then narrow it with form_ids, team_id or dates. Formcarry API: GET /v1/submissions.

created_after.description: Created at or after this time (RFC 3339, or milliseconds since the epoch).

created_before.description: Created before this time (RFC 3339, or milliseconds since the epoch).

country.description: Two-letter uppercase country code. Several codes separated by commas (max 20), e.g. DE,AT.

q.description: Only submissions where any field contains this text (literal, case-insensitive, 2-512 characters).

limit.description: Total matches to return across all forms searched (1-100, default 25). No pages.

fields.description: Comma-separated submitted field names to return, e.g. email,name. Other submission data still comes back.

team_id.description: Only this team. Use when the key covers several teams.

form_ids.description: Comma-separated form ids to search. Forms the key cannot read are left out.

tools.name: formcarry_list_submission_deliveries
tools.title: Read submission deliveries
tools.description: Show what happened to up to 20 submissions of one form: whether notification emails and webhooks were sent. Pass the submission ids as a comma-separated list. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}/submissions/deliveries.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

submission_ids.description: 1 to 20 submission ids of this form, comma-separated.

tools.name: formcarry_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks that send one form's submissions to an outside URL. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}/webhooks.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

tools.name: formcarry_get_webhook
tools.title: Get a webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook of a form: its target URL, event settings and last delivery. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}/webhooks/{webhook_id}.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

tools.name: formcarry_list_webhook_deliveries
tools.title: List webhook deliveries
tools.description: List the delivery attempts of one webhook, newest first, with status (succeeded, failed, retrying, pending, skipped). Filter by status, and page with before. Use it to debug a webhook that did not arrive. Formcarry API: GET /v1/forms/{form_id}/webhooks/{webhook_id}/deliveries.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

before.description: Page back from this delivery cursor (from the previous page).

tools.name: formcarry_mark_submission_spam
tools.title: Mark a submission as spam
tools.description: Move one submission to spam. It leaves the inbox but is not deleted; formcarry_restore_submission undoes it. Needs the submissions:write scope. Formcarry API: POST /v1/forms/{form_id}/submissions/{submission_id}/spam.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).

tools.name: formcarry_restore_submission
tools.title: Restore a submission from spam
tools.description: Move one spam submission back to the inbox. Needs the submissions:write scope. Formcarry API: POST /v1/forms/{form_id}/submissions/{submission_id}/restore.

form_id.description: The form id, as shown in the dashboard and in the form's endpoint URL (e.g. AbC123xyz).
